subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
14. 
ABC Ltd. operates a simple chemical process to convert a single material 
into three separate items, referred to here as X, Y and Z. All three end 
products are separated simultaneously at a single split-off point. 
 
Product X and Y are ready for sale immediately upon split off without 
further processing or any other additional costs. Product Z, however, is 
processed further before being sold. There is no available market price 
for Z at the split-off point. 
 
The selling prices quoted here are expected to remain the same in the 
coming year. During 2024-25, the selling prices of the items and the 
total amounts sold were: 
 
X – 186 tons sold for ` 3,000 per ton 
 
Y – 527 tons sold for ` 2,250 per ton 
 
Z – 736 tons sold for ` 1,500 per ton 
 
The total joint manufacturing costs for the year were ` 12,50,000. An 
additional ` 6,20,000 was spent to finish product Z. 
 
There were no opening inventories of X, Y or Z at the end of the year. 
The following inventories of complete units were on hand: 
X 
180 tons 
Y 
60 Tons 
Z 
25 tons 
There was no opening or closing work-in-progress. 
 
 

 
COST AND MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTING 
 
 
19 
 
MAY 2026 EXAMINATION 
REVISION TEST PAPERS 
Required: 
 
COMPUTE the cost of inventories of X, Y and Z and cost of goods sold 
for year ended March 31, 2025, using Net realizable value (NRV) method 
of joint cost allocation. 
Standard Costing
